description: This file defines the MessageCommand interface for sending messages to things and features within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes constants, method signatures, default implementations, and nested classes for JSON field definitions related to message commands.

classes.name: MessageCommand.JsonFields
classes.description: Contains JSON field definitions for MessageCommand's JSON representation, including thingId, message, headers, and payload.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Retrieves the Message object to be delivered.

methods.name: getTypePrefix
methods.description: Returns the type prefix for message commands.

methods.name: getMessageType
methods.description: Returns the message type used as routing key for AMQP delivery.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ThingId associated with the command.

methods.name: getResourceType
methods.description: Returns the resource type string, which is 'message'.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Sets Ditto headers for the command.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Constructs and returns the JSON pointer path for the message resource based on message direction, subject, and optional feature ID.
